methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Utilizing a dataset with 30-minute to weekly interval readings, CNN, DNN, and RNN models were applied across 12 datasets to identify the most effective model for baseline prediction using key IPMVP performance metrics (CVRMSE, NMBE, R2) alongside MAPE and RMSE.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This study utilizes data from a glove manufacturing site in Malaysia, selected for its stable conditions—no energy conservation measures (ECMs) implemented and consistent building characteristics—making it an ideal candidate for baseline energy modeling.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The company under study is located in Malaysia, operating within the healthcare industry. It specializes in the production of rubber gloves, utilizing synthetic latex as its primary raw material.

stage1.notes: Rubber-glove/healthcare manufacturing is not in the closed Level 3B sector list, although the facility reports continuous production 24 h a day.

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: The production facility operates around the clock, divided into three shifts, ensuring continuous production 24 h a day.

mv_protocol.evidence_quote: In industrial energy management, the International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol (IPMVP) has become the standardized framework for quantifying energy savings

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: The DNN, CNN, and RNN models in this study are specially tailored to enhance accuracy and performance in the M&V process using regression method.
